title: oven-roasted crunchy pepper meal
description: a sour, crunchy, vegan-friendly brazilian dish featuring mixed peppers. perfect for meal prep.

ingredients.name: mixed peppers
ingredients.notes: any combination of red, yellow, green, orange, and purple peppers, sliced into sashimi-cut strips

instructions: line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
arrange the pepper strips and chopped cilantro in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
drizzle with coconut oil and sprinkle with black pepper, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika.
roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
remove the baking sheet from the oven and carefully drizzle with apple cider vinegar.
toss to coat the peppers and return to the oven for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until slightly caramelized.
remove the baking sheet from the oven and let cool completely before serving.
